events.title: Veil of Madness: Deckbuilding systems Part 1
events.summary: Sophia’s mind has rules and your role decides which ones you break.Sophia’s mind is not one world. Her mind is layered, fractured, and governed by logic that shifts the deeper you go.Veil of Madness features four starting characters. Each one approaches the horror of Sophia’s consciousness differently. Each one has different approaches to deck building and none of them play alike. events.title: As the lanterns flicker and reason fades — the Veil of Madness calls
